comment: Dr. Spera has been doing this forever, she knows how to help you in nearly any situation. GEOG250 is usually taken out of obligation, but a good chunk of the course is genuinely fascinating. Make sure to work with others on labs; you'll need the help / combined effort. Don't fall behind on labwork. Make a personal quiz study guide. Good class!

I took her 360 class. The class is difficult filled with technical concepts. Would be very challenging for anyone without prior physics/remote sensing knowledge.  However, she is a very nice person and accessible outside of class. Would definetly recommend her as a professor but not necessairly the 360 class if taking as elective.

Highly receptive to student feedback and does not hesitate to do what she can to help you succeed. The course is a lot of little assignments and a big final project to gradually build knowledge in an approachable way. The GIS and contract grading schemes for this class threw me for a loop at first, but Dr. Spera was helpful with parsing those parts
